title: Kinetic Motion Design Showreel (code-made, 'CLAUDE motion designer')
summary: A 15 s code-rendered motion showreel that runs through motion-design ideas in 8 bar-long chapters: a radar dot that blooms into an asterisk, the word CLAUDE wiped in by a circle iris, an easing-curves chart, a triangle burst, truchet-tile patterns, a dot-sphere, NEVER marquee type and an end card. Flat poster colours, a thin HUD frame with timecode/BPM, and every scene change lands on a 4-beat bar at 128 BPM. Feels confident, graphic and Swiss-poster precise.
fit_reason: The HUD frame, beat-locked chapters and the 'six ways to get from A to B' chart-style scene suit a premium tech brand, but the loud poster colours and abstract shapes say design studio, not client portal.

palette.mood: high-contrast flat poster colours; each chapter owns one full-bleed colour (black, vermilion, ultramarine, acid lime, off-white)

typography.display: extra-wide heavy grotesk (Druk Wide / Monument Extended look) for CLAUDE, EASE, OUT., NEVER; serif italic (Instrument Serif look) for 'motion designer' and 'Six ways to get from A to B'; tiny monospace for the HUD and metadata
typography.case: upper for display, lower italic for subtitles
typography.size_behaviour: huge, full-width words that overflow the frame; tiny mono labels in corners
typography.notes: Wide-black-caps + italic-serif-subtitle + mono-micro-labels is the full type system. End card: asterisk logo left of CLAUDE, italic subtitle under it, a hairline rule, then a row of mono metadata ('SHOWREEL 2026 / 15 SECONDS / EVERY FRAME WRITTEN IN CODE / AVAILABLE FOR NEW PROJECTS').

text_animation: letters slide in behind a circular iris mask that grows from centre (CLAUDE at 2.0 s)
per-letter horizontal motion blur with RGB chromatic fringing on fast moves (EASE, OUT.)
word slides through frame at speed, settling with ease-out
marquee rows of outline + solid NEVER scrolling in opposite directions
end card logo + wordmark slide in with slight overshoot and jitter
motion: circle iris grows to fill frame and becomes the next background
easing-curve demo: dots race across tracks with linear/ease-in/ease-out/back/elastic/bounce
radial burst of triangles around a play icon
truchet tile field with a red ripple travelling through it
asterisk spins and scales up from a dot
motion blur + chromatic aberration on every fast move
transitions: hard cut on the bar (every 1.875 s = 4 beats at 128 BPM)
circle iris wipe (shape grows to become the next colour field)
colour-field swap with the same shape continuing
fast stutter cuts 11.2-12.6 s (every ~0.23 s, one per beat-eighth)
graphic_elements: HUD frame: corner brackets, timecode bottom-left, '120 FPS', 'BAR 3/8' and progress bar bottom-right, chapter label top-right ('01 - IDENTITY', '06 - KINETIC TYPE')
ui_treatment: none (the 'Six ways to get from A to B' easing chart is the closest thing: a clean labelled table of tracks with moving dots)

sound.music: electronic beat, 128 BPM (shown in HUD), loud master (-13 LUFS)
sound.sfx: likely synced hits/whooshes on each shape move
sound.sync: yes: every chapter change on a bar line, stutter cuts on 8th notes

signature_moves: HUD frame with chapter label, timecode, BPM and bar counter that stays on top of every scene
one flat full-bleed colour per chapter, swapped by a growing circle
wide black caps + italic serif subtitle + mono micro-labels
motion blur with RGB fringing on every fast move

best_segments.what: Dot grows into a circle iris that wipes to vermilion; CLAUDE slides in behind the mask with motion blur, then dots fly into the easing chart.
'Six ways to get from A to B' easing chart on off-white: labelled tracks, dots racing with different easing curves. Closest thing to an explainer chart.
Stutter-cut kinetic type (EASE / OUT. / NEVER marquee) then end card with logo, italic subtitle and mono metadata row.

recreate.how: HTML + GSAP (or Remotion). Build a fixed HUD layer (corner brackets, mono timecode, bar counter). Set a 128 BPM grid (bar = 1.875 s) and put each chapter on one bar. Use SVG circle scale for iris wipes, CSS filter blur + offset red/blue text-shadow copies for chromatic motion blur, a tiled SVG truchet pattern, and a canvas dot-sphere. End card: asterisk SVG + wide heavy caps + italic serif + mono row.
recreate.prompt: 15-second code-made motion showreel on a 128 BPM grid. Each bar is a new flat full-bleed colour (near-black #0f0f11, vermilion #f04b3a, ultramarine #302ff6, acid lime #e3ff46, off-white #f2efe7). Thin HUD frame with corner brackets, mono timecode, BPM and 'BAR 3/8'. Extra-wide black caps that slide in with motion blur and RGB fringing, italic serif subtitles, a growing-circle iris between colours, an easing-curves chart, and an end card with an asterisk logo.
